messages.subject: Open work session tomorrow 10AM, Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi all,

We'll have our first open work session of the quarter tomorrow (Friday) 10-12 in Wickson 2124.  

For our new members who just signed up, our work sessions are open times to come and co-work on your own projects (including work for classes), and ask and answer questions on R, statistics and related topics.

We're also supplied with cookies from Girl Scout Troop 989, thanks to our sponsors at Revolution Analytics.

Next week (Apr 9) our work session will open with a talk from Jaime Ashander on approaches to visualizing generalized linear models (GLMs).

- Noam
